Q5984.reason: Anaerobic respiration is a cellular metabolic process, not a breathing pattern, whereas Cheyne-Stokes, hyperventilation and ataxic breathing are all seen in head injury.

Q5988.reason: The officer's testimony is the defendant's own out-of-court statement, so it is admissible as a party admission when offered against him.

Q5991.reason: Under County of Riverside v. McLaughlin, a warrantless arrestee must get a prompt probable cause determination, generally within 48 hours, so 14 days is unconstitutional.
